numericDefectPostmortem.symptom: capacity values were off by 2^32 (Q96 computed as 2^128)
numericDefectPostmortem.rootCause: U256::from_limbs([0,0,1,0]) is 2^128, not 2^96; from_limbs takes [u64;4] in little-endian limb order
numericDefectPostmortem.fix: Q96 = U256::from_limbs([0, 4_294_967_296, 0, 0]); liquidity_q96 uses `U256::from(liquidity) << 96` because ruint `*` silently wraps on overflow while `<<` is exact

numericDefectPostmortem.symptom: fallback backend disagreed with the SDK backend on token0 amounts
numericDefectPostmortem.rootCause: get_next_sqrt_price_from_amount_1_rounding_down used mul_div(L, amount, Q96) instead of amount * Q96 / L
numericDefectPostmortem.fix: (amount << 96) / L when amount <= U160_MAX, otherwise mul_div(amount, Q96, L)

numericDefectPostmortem.symptom: price impact exceeded 10 bps even for near-zero trades
numericDefectPostmortem.rootCause: realized output was compared against the gross spot output, charging the LP fee as price impact; the Python reference implementation sets priceImpactFeeExcluded=True
numericDefectPostmortem.fix: compare realized output against spot_amount_out(fee_adjusted_input(amount, fee_pips)) computed in U256 to avoid u128 overflow
